newsitem.title: CANADA: Cambior wins Guyana exploration rights.
newsitem.headline: Cambior wins Guyana exploration rights.

text.p: Cambior Inc and Denver-based Golden Star Resources Ltd said on Thursday that Omai Gold Mines Ltd has been granted exploration rights for two adjacent blocks of land in Guyana.
The blocks of land, Quartz Hill and Omai River, have a strategic location covering an area of 50 square kilometres each, with promising gold potential, the companies said in a statement.
They will be integrated into the Omai mine concession, bringing the total area covered by Omai Gold Mines to 153 square kilometres.
A budget of US$1 million has been allocated for 1997 to start exploration.
Cambior operates the Omai mine and holds a 65 percent interest in Omai Gold Mines. Golden Star holds a 30 percent interest. The Government of Guyana holds five percent.
